verdict.rationale: Oyster documents its own embedding offering: Oyster Embedded with embeddable web components, an API to embed global hiring and employment in your application, and reseller/partner API use cases. However, the embedded scope shown is hiring and employment (EOR onboarding, engagements, bonuses, allowances), not payroll itself, and white-labeling is never stated. Missing for 10: explicit payroll endpoints or embedded payroll components, documented white-label/branding controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of embedded partner deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API

citations.quote: Supercharge your platform using Oyster Embedded. ... Embeddable Web Components
